create_tokenizer_p10: create a P10Tokenizer with configurable num_digits and exponent_range for float tokenization
create_tokenizer_ieee: create an IEEEFloatTokenizer with configurable base and digit counts for IEEE-style float tokenization
create_tokenizer_normalized: create a NormalizedTokenizer for tokenizing floats in [0,1] with configurable base and length
wrap_tokenizer_special: wrap a DecoderTokenizer with AddSpecialValues to handle INVALID, NAN, INF, and NINF tokens
wrap_tokenizer_pad: wrap a DecoderTokenizer with AppendPadTokenizer to append a pad separator token after each object
